dogecoin.text: @DaoKwonDo's journey included notable successes with investments in Shiba Inu and Dogecoin, though not without setbacks during the infamous DeFi summer of 2021. His ability to bounce back and maintain wealth speaks volumes of his strategic acumen in the volatile crypto market.

This shift marked the beginning of his full-time engagement with cryptocurrency, a decision that paid dividends as he navigated through the highs of investments like Shiba Inu and Dogecoin and the lows of the DeFi summer in 2021.
